svg.title: NGM_SHOWCASE
svg.desc: Schematic electropherogram reconstructed from called allele identifiers and RFU heights. Horizontal called-peak positions mix measured fragment sizes exported by the source software, nominal kit display coordinates, and repeat-based estimated coordinates; each peak records its coordinate source.

svg.text: Kit: AmpFlSTR NGM PCR Amplification Kit (Applied Biosystems / Life Technologies) · nominal coordinate model 0.4-ngm1 · called peaks: 31
Schematic reconstruction: only peaks called in the GeneMapper genotype export are shown. No baseline, uncalled artefacts or additional stutter peaks are generated.

Horizontal called-peak positions mix measured fragment sizes exported by the source software, nominal kit display coordinates, and repeat-based estimated coordinates; each peak records its coordinate source.
